text:
nina: quick question — can we add a small hint in the Console next to service account API keys that shows which routing pool (hosted/dedicated/private) requests are currently going to?
kevin: sounds useful for debugging quota spikes. thinking of a low-noise badge like `Routing: hosted (fallback: dedicated)`
jon: +1. do we want this live per-request or sampled? per-request might be noisy at scale.
sam: sampled with recent-most mapping for the key makes sense. show last 5m majority and a link to the routing timeline.
tasha: UX flag: avoid exposing internal pool names to customers — maybe human-friendly labels (e.g., "Shared Hosted", "Reserved") and a tooltip with more detail only for admins.
kevin: agreed. backend needs to join routing_decisions table with keys table. We currently emit routing decision event to telemetry, but it's keyed by request_id not api_key_id. small change to include `api_key_id` in the event. low-risk?
jon: should be fine but watch perf. that event is emitted in fast path. can we add it conditionally behind a feature flag so we can roll out?
nina: feature flag + sampling policy. default off for orgs with >1000 rps. toggle per-org for support.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-producer v2 -> canary on alpha at 1733332230 by deploy-bot :rocket:
kevin: implementation note — telemetry schema: add `api_key_id` (string), `routing_pool` (string), `routing_variant` (string). keep backwards compat by adding new fields optional.
sam: also capture `quota_band` at decision time so Console can show "Quota tier: X (reason: org-commitment)". avoids jumping in the UI when a transient throttle happens.
tasha: +1 for quota_band. for privacy we should hash api_key_id in analytics store and keep mapping in internal DB only for Console.
jon: hash is ok for aggregated signals, but Console needs to resolve to the actual key label. store mapping in internal read-only service with RBAC.
nina: follow-up: do we want a "routing explain" button in the key detail view that opens a lightweight modal with timeline and last 3 decisions?
kevin: yes — modal can call /internal/keys/{id}/routing-explain that returns sampled events. protect with admin perms.
sam: API shape suggestion:
```
GET /internal/keys/ABC123/routing-explain?window=5m&limit=50
response: [ { ts: 1733332000, pool: "hosted", variant: "gpu-v2", reason: "capacity-signal" }, ... ]
```
jon: that looks fine. rate-limit the endpoint to avoid abuse. cache 30s.
tasha: for rollout plan: 1) telemetry event change behind flag, 2) add Console badge (internal only) 3) enable modal + sample API 4) expose to support orgs 5) gradual public release with opt-in.
kevin: estimate: 3 dev days + 1 oncall day for monitoring. can we ship step 1 this week?
nina: i'll open RFC and assign owners. @kevin can you own the telemetry change? @jon take the internal service and endpoint? sam you do Console UI?
kevin: yep. starting PR today.
jon: will spin up a small read-only mapping service.
sam: prepping UI mockups, will post in #design in a bit.
tasha: also want a small dashboard tile in Ops -> Routing showing % of traffic per pool for top 10 keys. helpful for capacity planning.
nina: love that. add to roadmap. thanks all :pray:
